## Content standards All 11 created tasks have clean titles, self-contained descriptions, correctly marked and verifiable `## Success Criteria`, exactly one `type:task` label, and the meaningful `epic:artifact-archival` membership label. No sibling-ID prose, ordinal/title prefixes, or duplicated dependency sections were found. Prior finding resolved: `0c86d83b` now specifies in `REQ-10` that a missing root produces `missing-source`, while a missing embedded target produces `missing-edge-target`, adds no destination constraint, and is excluded from edge validation. ## Coverage vs. design The inventory exactly matches the eleven work items in §3 of `dev/active/7d3a3a47-plan.md`. No missing, extra, merged, or wrongly split deliverables were found. | Design item | Issue | Matches? | |---|---|---| | Artifact plan model and blocker taxonomy | `28fb4e6a` | Yes | | Target root inventory and ownership | `b45ad545` | Yes | | Recursive supported-dependency discovery | `971c67f4` | Yes | | Move/copy/retain/block classification | `0c86d83b` | Yes | | Storage-owned artifact mutation primitive | `67f4ded1` | Yes | | Unified archive preview surface | `41aa6056` | Yes | | Archive intent and recovery selection | `f205aa7e` | Yes | | Receipt-backed publication and reference commit | `1e6fce38` | Yes | | Source-removal reconciliation and crash recovery | `b8281931` | Yes | | Remove the legacy document-archive command | `271dc224` | Yes | | Read-only container candidate report | `a9f8e04d` | Yes | ## Dependency DAG correctness Implemented transitive ordering matches §3: - `28fb4e6a → b45ad545 → 971c67f4 → 0c86d83b` - `0c86d83b` fans out independently to `41aa6056` and `a9f8e04d` - Independent root `67f4ded1` joins `41aa6056` at `f205aa7e` - Executor chain: `f205aa7e → 1e6fce38 → b8281931 → 271dc224` The omitted direct edges listed redundantly in the design are present transitively, consistent with transitive reduction. No false serialization or missing prerequisite was found. The two implementation roots, `28fb4e6a` and `67f4ded1`, can both begin on a fresh workspace because each adds to existing project structures and neither requires sibling-created scaffolding. ## Structural integrity All eleven tasks are reachable from `7d3a3a47`; none is isolated or dangling. The planning/breakdown spine remains reachable through the two implementation roots. The flat task tier is explicitly justified in §3: each task is intended as an independently landable, green deliverable, while the formerly oversized executor was split into the three-task chain `f205aa7e`, `1e6fce38`, and `b8281931`. The instantiated scopes uphold that rationale. ## Findings
    Total findings: 0 <<>> VERDICT: PASS --- Gate result: PASSED

findings.summary: All eleven planned work items are present, standards-compliant, correctly ordered, structurally reachable, and the prior classifier finding is resolved.
